tasks.title: Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed the over-refund bug in payment/service.go. Refund compared the requested amount to the full payment amount instead of what was left. It now compares against Amount - Refunded. An oversized refund returns ErrRefundExceedsRemaining, which the API maps to 422 refund_exceeds_remaining, and the payment isn't changed. A refund of exactly the remaining amount is still allowed and moves the payment to REFUNDED. I added a regression test (600 then 600 on 1000 is rejected, then 400 succeeds and the status becomes REFUNDED). The full suite passes with -race, and gofmt reports nothing.
